title: Autonomy
description: The autonomy of a process with its reason (ADR-0026): the level it runs at, why it runs at that level, and what is missing to go one level higher. The direction is always towards level 4 and never forced: a process whose requirements do not allow a higher level stays where it is, and toward_next says what forbids it. At level 4 there is no next level and toward_next is absent. Shown wherever the process is shown. See docs/architecture/governance.md.

reason.description: Why the process runs at this level: what the level rests on — the evidence, the anchors, the exactness of its results, the trust it has earned.

toward_next.description: What is missing to go one level higher — a demonstrated quality history, a check that does not exist yet, an anchor that would have to move — or what forbids it where the process's requirements do not allow the next level. Required below level 4; absent at level 4.
